body.description: Bonnetbloom: a patch of tall blue-violet lupine wildflowers grown into a small creature, flower spikes as a crown, leafy body, roots tangled with an old buried cable that glows faintly, sleepy kind eyes; a plant creature, not a machine. a small living machine creature (an Ohm), an old household or farm machine that woke up with a will of its own, weathered by years outdoors, no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
